services.title: Ibyo dutanga
services.lead: Serivisi icyenda ahantu hamwe, ku buryo abenshi bivuza bakarangiza uwo munsi. Ibiciro byerekanwe ni urugero; umwakiranyi akwemeza igiciro mbere yo kwivuza.

book.title: Fata gahunda mu ntambwe eshatu
book.lead: Uwaje atafashe gahunda arakirwa buri gihe. Gufata gahunda mbere bigabanya igihe utegereza kandi bigafasha muganga gutegura dosiye yawe.
book.step1: Twoherereze kuri WhatsApp cyangwa SMS izina ryawe, serivisi ukeneye n’umunsi n’isaha wifuza — cyangwa uhamagare aho bakirira abarwayi.
book.step2: Mu isaha imwe, mu masaha dufungura, uhabwa ubutumwa bwemeza isaha ya gahunda yawe na muganga uzakwakira.
book.step3: Zana indangamuntu yawe. Uhabwa nimero, mugaragaza ikakwereka igihe cyawe kigeze.
book.emergency: Ntibikoreshwa ku byihutirwa. Niba hari uri mu kaga hamagara 912 (SAMU) cyangwa uze ku ivuriro ako kanya.

form.stationHint: Izina ry’aho akorera rigaragara kuri mugaragaza no ku matike. Rihe izina ry’icyumba (Amenyo 1, Icyumba cyo kubagiramo…): umurongo w’uyu mukozi ufungukira aho.

Nuhitamo ishami rifite serivisi, ni ryo rizajya rigena.

login.lead: Andika izina ryo kwinjira na PIN. Hanyuma twohereza kode y’imibare itandatu kuri imeyili yawe.
login.failed: Izina ryo kwinjira cyangwa PIN si byo. Ongera ugerageze cyangwa usabe umuyobozi kuguha PIN nshya.
login.inactive: Iyi konti yahagaritswe. Baza umuyobozi w’ivuriro.
login.codeLead: Twohereje kode y’imibare itandatu kuri {{email}}. Ikora iminota 10.
login.codeWrong: Kode si yo. Reba imeyili yawe wongere ugerageze.
login.linkMismatch: Iri huza ryo kwinjira ni irya {{got}}, si irya {{expected}}. Nta winjiye. Fungura imeyili iheruka koherezwa kuri {{expected}}, cyangwa wongere winjire.
login.codeOrLink: Imeyili iva kuri Muhazi Medical Clinic Ltd ifite umutwe “… is your sign-in code”. Ikora iminota 10. Ntiyaje nyuma y’umunota umwe? Reba muri Spam cyangwa Promotions, cyangwa usabe indi kode.
login.error: Hari ikitagenze neza. Reba interineti wongere ugerageze.
login.otpSendFailed: Kode ntiyashoboye koherezwa kuri imeyili yawe. Saba umuyobozi kugenzura imeyili yawe.
login.codeSample: Uburyo bw’igerageza: imibare itandatu iyo ari yo yose irakora.
login.trustHint: Ubutaha kuri iyi mashakisha, nimero y’umukozi, izina ryo kwinjira na PIN birahagije — nta kode ya imeyili kugeza igihe cyo kwizerwa kirangiye. Kuraho akamenyetso kuri mudasobwa ihuriweho.
login.firstPinLead: Ni ubwa mbere winjira ukoresheje PIN wahawe n’umuyobozi. Hitamo imibare itandatu uzi wenyine; hanyuma kode yoherezwa kuri imeyili yawe kugira ngo uyemeze.
login.firstPinSaved: PIN yawe yabitswe. Andika kode tumaze kukoherereza.
login.sessionHint: Ukomeza kuba winjiye igihe cyose ukora. Nyuma y’amasaha nta cyo ukora, cyangwa iyo usohotse, uzakenera kode nshya.

ended.idle_other: Wasohowe nyuma y’amasaha {{count}} nta cyo ukora.

ended.next: Ongera winjire: nimero y’umukozi, izina ryo kwinjira na PIN, hanyuma kode nshya tukoherereza kuri imeyili.
ended.security: Ku bw’umutekano wawe, ongera winjire ukoresheje kode yoherejwe kuri imeyili yawe.

login.notApproved: Kode ni yo, ariko sisitemu y’ivuriro ntiyashoboye kwemeza kwinjira kwawe. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y’umunota umwe. Nibikomeza, bimenyeshe umuyobozi.
login.tooMany: Wagerageje inshuro nyinshi. Tegereza iminota 15, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
login.resendPinLead: Andika PIN yawe kugira ngo twohereze kode nshya.

register.title: Kwandika umurwayi
register.lead: Andika umurwayi mushya cyangwa usanzwe, umwohereze aho agomba kujya.
register.emergency: Byihutirwa: umutuku, aba uwa mbere ku murongo w’aho uhitamo ukurikiraho
register.triageHint: Umurwayi ahabwa itike akajya ku bipimo by’ibanze gufatwa ibipimo bya mbere.

done.title: Umurwayi yanditswe
done.where: Umurwayi yabitswe ku rutonde rw’abarwayi. Kwivuza kwe kugikomeje kandi ari ku murongo w’ibipimo by’ibanze (ku muforomo), aho afatirwa ibipimo mbere yo kujya kwa muganga.
done.triageNote: Itike yatanzwe. Umurwayi ajya ku bipimo by’ibanze gufatwa ibipimo, hanyuma akajya aho agomba kuvurirwa.
done.emergencyNote: Byihutirwa: umurwayi ni we wa mbere ku murongo wa {{station}}.
done.deskNote: Itike yatanzwe. Umurwayi ari ku murongo wa {{station}}.
done.whereDesk: Umurwayi yanditswe; kwivuza kwe kugikomeje kandi ari ku murongo wa {{station}}. Andika ibipimo kuri mugaragaza yo kwivuza cyangwa ku rupapuro rw’Ibipimo.

register.emergencyHint: Hanyuma uhitemo aho ajya (aho ukorera niba umwakira ubwawe). Andika dosiye ubu cyangwa umurwayi akimara gukomera.
register.searchLabel: Shakisha ukoresheje izina, nimero ya dosiye, telefoni cyangwa indangamuntu
register.noMatch: Nta murwayi wabonetse. Andika dosiye nshya iburyo.

errors.openVisit: Uyu murwayi asanzwe afite kwivuza kugikomeje.

noId.label: Indangamuntu
noId.childHint: Ku mwana, andika telefoni y’umubyeyi cyangwa umurera n’izina rye nk’uwo guhamagara mu gihe cyihutirwa muri dosiye.

register.deskHint: Umurwayi ahabwa itike akajya aho wahisemo. Ibipimo bishobora gufatirwa aho, cyangwa mbere n’umuforomo.

fileOnly.title: Dosiye nshya y’umurwayi
fileOnly.hint: Hafungurwa dosiye gusa ubu; kwivuza gutangira umurwayi ageze kuri gahunda. Dosiye nshya ihita ishyirwa kuri gahunda.

register.flow: Shaka umurwayi cyangwa wandike dosiye nshya, hanyuma uhitemo aho ajya.
register.flowTriageFirst: Shaka umurwayi cyangwa wandike dosiye nshya. “Ibipimo by’ibanze mbere” birakora: umurwayi abanza kubona umuforomo, keretse umwakiriye ubwawe.
register.savedOnly: Dosiye ya {{name}} yabitswe ({{file}}). Nta kwivuza kwatangiye: kanda “Tangira kwivuza” umurwayi niteguye.

duplicate.line: Birashoboka ko dosiye isanzweho: {{name}} {{file}} — fungura iyo dosiye aho kwandika indi?

triage.title: Ibipimo
triage.empty: Abarwayi bose bari mu ivuriro bafite ibipimo.
triage.select: Hitamo umurwayi ibumoso kugira ngo wandike ibipimo.
triage.readOnly: Abaforomo n’abaganga ni bo bonyine bandika ibipimo.
triage.lockedFor: Yoherejwe kwa {{name}}: ni {{name}} wenyine ufata ibipimo akohereza uyu murwayi aho akurikira. Ushobora kureba ariko ntugire icyo uhindura.
triage.lockedSection: Abaforomo bakora ku bipimo by’ibanze ni bo bonyine bafata ibipimo bakohereza uyu murwayi aho akurikira. Ushobora kureba ariko ntugire icyo uhindura.

settings.title: Igenamiterere ry’ivuriro
settings.lead: Uyobora ivuriro ryose uhereye hano: umwirondoro n’aho twandikirwa bigaragara ku rubuga, amasaha dufungura agena “Rirafunguye ubu” n’ingengabihe ya gahunda, n’inzira ngufi zigana aho bakorera hose.

profile.title: Umwirondoro w’ivuriro n’aho twandikirwa
profile.lead: Bigaragara ku rubuga rusange, ku nyemezabwishyu no mu butumwa. Impinduka zigaragara ako kanya.

hours.title: Amasaha dufungura
hours.lead: Kuri buri munsi: amasaha 24, amasaha uhisemo cyangwa rirafunze. Laboratwari ifite amasaha yayo.

patientFields.title: Ibice bya dosiye y’umurwayi
patientFields.lead: Ongeraho amakuru ivuriro ryifuza kuri buri dosiye y’umurwayi arenze asanzwe (idini, indwara idakira, umuntu wa hafi, nimero y’ikarita y’ubwishingizi…). Abakozi bayuzuza kuri dosiye y’umurwayi.
patientFields.label: Izina ry’igice
patientFields.optionsPh: Nta yo, Diyabete, Umuvuduko w’amaraso, Virusi itera SIDA, Asima
patientFields.saved: Ibice byabitswe. Ubu bigaragara kuri buri dosiye y’umurwayi.
patientFields.privateHint: ababibona ni abavura umurwayi n’abemerewe kureba amateka yose; aho bakirira abarwayi bashobora kubyuzuza iyo birimo ubusa ariko ntibabibona

lock.title: Gufunga mugaragaza
lock.lead: Iyo nta muntu ukoze kuri mugaragaza y’umukozi muri iki gihe, irifunga igasaba PIN. Umunota umwe mbere, haza integuza; gukoraho cyangwa gukanda bituma igumaho. Gufunga bigumana urupapuro uko rwari ruri, nta kazi kabura.
lock.saved: Byabitswe. Kuva ubu mugaragaza zose z’abakozi zirabikoresha.

otp.title: Kode yo kwinjira yoherezwa kuri imeyili
otp.lead: Kode zoherezwa na Gmail y’ivuriro, yemera imeyili nka 500 ku munsi. Nyuma ya kode imwe nyayo umuntu ashobora kwizera igikoresho cye; kuri icyo gikoresho nimero y’umukozi, izina ryo kwinjira na PIN biba bihagije kugeza igihe cyo kwizerwa kirangiye.
otp.days_one: Rimwe kuri buri gikoresho, hanyuma cyizerwa umunsi {{count}}
otp.days_other: Rimwe kuri buri gikoresho, hanyuma cyizerwa iminsi {{count}}
otp.revokeAll: Ongera usabe kode ku bikoresho byose
otp.saved: Byabitswe. Birakurikizwa uhereye ku kwinjira gukurikira.
otp.hint: Koresha “Ongera usabe kode ku bikoresho byose” iyo telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa yabuze, cyangwa umukozi avuye mu ivuriro.

beds.title: Ibitanda n’igiciro cy’ijoro
beds.lead: Umubare w’ibitanda ivuriro rifite n’igiciro cy’ijoro rimwe. Abakozi babona ibitanda biri ubusa, kandi kurara byishyurwa amajoro × iki giciro (cyangwa igiciro cyemeranyijweho).
beds.mixed: Ibitanda bifite ibiciro bitandukanye. Andika igiciro kugira ngo byose bigire kimwe, cyangwa uhindure buri gitanda hepfo.
beds.name: Izina ry’igitanda

settings.leadShort: Ibyo ushyiraho byose ku ivuriro, igice ku kindi.

access.title: Ninde ukora iki
access.hint: Ibikorwa kuri buri mwanya na buri mukozi

flow.title: Inzira y’umurwayi
flow.deskFirstHint: Aho bakirira abarwayi bohereza umurwayi kwa muganga (cyangwa ahandi bakorera). Ibipimo bifatirwa aho cyangwa bigafatwa n’umuforomo ku rupapuro rw’Ibipimo.
flow.triageFirstHint: Buri murwayi anyura ku bipimo by’ibanze: umuforomo afata ibipimo, ahitamo ibara, akohereza umurwayi aho akwiye kujya.
flow.saved: Byabitswe. Abandikishwa bashya bakurikiza iyi nzira.
flow.vitalsNote: Uko byagenda kose, buri mugaragaza yerekana niba ibipimo byafashwe.

session.title: Igihe umara winjiye
session.lead_one: Mugaragaza iguma yinjiye igihe cyose ikoreshwa. Nyuma y’isaha {{count}} nta gikorwa, irasohoka, kandi kongera kwinjira bisaba kode nshya yoherejwe kuri imeyili.
session.lead_other: Mugaragaza iguma yinjiye igihe cyose ikoreshwa. Nyuma y’amasaha {{count}} nta gikorwa, irasohoka, kandi kongera kwinjira bisaba kode nshya yoherejwe kuri imeyili.
session.rule1_one: Buri rupapuro rufunguye muri mushakisha rubara ibikorwa byarwo: gukanda, kwandika, gukora kuri mugaragaza cyangwa kumanura. Nyuma y’isaha {{count}} nta na kimwe, rurasohoka.
session.rule1_other: Buri rupapuro rufunguye muri mushakisha rubara ibikorwa byarwo: gukanda, kwandika, gukora kuri mugaragaza cyangwa kumanura. Nyuma y’amasaha {{count}} nta na kimwe, rurasohoka.
session.rule2: Iminota 10 mbere, haza integuza; gukanda cyangwa kwandika bituma umuntu akomeza kuba yinjiye.
session.rule3: Gusohoka, cyangwa PIN 5 zitari zo kuri mugaragaza ifunze, bisohora impapuro zose z’uwo muntu muri iyi mushakisha, kandi kwinjira gukurikira bisaba kode nshya yoherejwe kuri imeyili.
session.rule4_one: Urundi rupapuro muri iyo mushakisha rwinjira rukoresheje nimero y’umukozi, izina ryo kwinjira na PIN, nta kode nshya, igihe cyose uwo muntu yari arukoreraho mu isaha {{count}} ishize.
session.rule4_other: Urundi rupapuro muri iyo mushakisha rwinjira rukoresheje nimero y’umukozi, izina ryo kwinjira na PIN, nta kode nshya, igihe cyose uwo muntu yari arukoreraho mu masaha {{count}} ashize.
session.rule5: “Funga mugaragaza ubu” igumisha akazi gafunguye inyuma ya PIN; igihe mugaragaza imaze ifunze kibarwa nk’igihe nta gikorwa.
session.saved: Byabitswe. Mugaragaza zifunguye zikurikiza amasaha mashya mu minota mike.
session.revokeHint: “Ongera usabe kode ku bikoresho byose” ihagarika urufunguzo rwa buri mushakisha: kwinjira gukurikira kwa buri wese bisaba kode nshya yoherejwe kuri imeyili. Mugaragaza zisanzwe zinjiye zigumamo.

pin.failed: PIN ntiyashoboye guhindurwa. Reba PIN isanzwe wongere ugerageze.
pin.ownLead: Andika PIN ukoresha ubu, hanyuma uhitemo imibare itandatu mishya uzi wenyine.

add.adjustHint: Si ngombwa. Andika 10 kuri 10 %, hitamo RWF ku mafaranga, cyangwa × ku kigwizo.

errors.noManual: Ubu buvuzi ntibwemera ikindi giciro. Koresha igabanywa, cyangwa usabe umuyobozi gushyira akamenyetso kuri “Muganga ashobora kwandika ikindi giciro”.
errors.discount: Igabanywa ni ijanisha riri hagati ya 0 na 100.
errors.overMax: Ushobora gutanga kugeza kuri {{pct}}% kuri ubu buvuzi. Saba umuyobozi kurenzaho.

add.title: Ongeraho ubuvuzi
add.medicinesElsewhere: Imiti yandikirwa mu nyandiko z’ubuvuzi (Urupapuro rw’imiti); hano wongeramo ubuvuzi na serivisi.
add.otherWarning: Ubu buvuzi ni ubw’irindi shami. Bwongereho gusa niba koko ari wowe ubutanze hano (urugero iyo nta mukozi w’iryo shami ufite umwanya).

payer.title: Uwishyura
payer.label: Uwishyura
payer.hint: Guhitamo ikigo cy’ubwishingizi byongera kugabanya buri cyishyurwa kuri iyi fagitire hakurikijwe ibyo cyishyura.
payer.noInsurers: Nta kigo cy’ubwishingizi kirakora: umurwayi yishyura amafaranga yose aho bakira ubwishyu.

payment.title: Ubwishyu
payment.nothingYet: Nta kiraba kuri fagitire y’uku kwivuza.
payment.settledOpen: Ibyishyuwe kugeza ubu. Inyemezabwishyu {{receipt}}. Kwivuza kurakomeje: ibizongerwaho bizishyurwa ku iherezo.
payment.settledDebt: Byishyuwe byose. Inyemezabwishyu {{receipt}}. Umwenda warishyuwe; kwivuza kuguma kurangiye.

next.title: Intambwe ikurikira y’uyu murwayi
next.lead: Iyo urangije hano, ohereza umurwayi aho akurikiraho. Bifunga umwanya we ku murongo wa {{station}}; umurwayi agaragara ku murongo w’aho wahisemo.
next.sectionLead: Urangije hano, hitamo icyo umurwayi akeneye gukurikiraho. Umuntu wese ukora muri iryo shami ashobora kumwakira, yaba muganga cyangwa umuforomo (uwa mbere ufite umwanya), cyangwa uhitemo umuntu umwe.

visit.closedBanner: Kwivuza kwarangiye {{when}}. Ibyanditswe byose biguma muri dosiye y’umurwayi.
visit.cashierNote: Ibipimo, ubuvuzi n’imiti byongerwamo n’abaganga n’abaforomo. Hano wakira ubwishyu.
visit.takeHint: Ni wowe umwitaho ubu: abo mukorana aha babona ko ari wowe umufite.

refund.title: Subiza amafaranga
refund.lead: Hari icyishyurwa cyavanyweho nyuma yo kwishyurwa: umurwayi yishyuye arenze fagitire. Subiza ikinyuranyo kandi uvuge impamvu.

patients.title: Abarwayi
patients.lead: Buri murwayi ivuriro ryanditse, na dosiye ye yose.
patients.none: Nta murwayi uhuye n’ibyo washatse. Reba uko izina ryanditswe cyangwa umwandike.

merge.title: Huza dosiye yanditswe kabiri
merge.lead: Umuntu umwe yanditswe kabiri? Shaka indi dosiye: kwivuza kwayo, gahunda, inyandiko n’ubwishingizi biza muri iyi dosiye, kandi nimero yayo ikomeza kubona umurwayi.
merge.done_one: {{dup}} yahujwe: ikintu {{count}} cyimuriwe muri iyi dosiye.
merge.done_other: {{dup}} yahujwe: ibintu {{count}} byimuriwe muri iyi dosiye.

file.visitStarted: Kwivuza kwatangiye. Itike {{ticket}}, ari ku murongo wa {{station}}.
file.noAllergies: Nta kizwi umubiri we wanga cyanditswe
file.moreLead: Ibice umuyobozi yongeyeho mu Igenamiterere bigaragara hano kuri buri murwayi. Ushobora no kongeraho igice cyihariye cy’uyu murwayi gusa.
file.fieldNamePh: urugero: Umuntu wa hafi, Idini, Nimero y’ikarita y’ubwishingizi
file.noExtra: Nta yandi makuru araba. Koresha “Ongeraho igice”, cyangwa umuyobozi ashyireho ibice bya buri murwayi mu Igenamiterere.
file.allergiesHint: Imiti, ibiryo cyangwa ibindi bitera umubiri kwivumbura (uduheri, kubyimba, guhumeka nabi) gusa. Ibindi bivugwa bijya mu Byitonderwa.
file.inClinicNow: Uyu murwayi ari mu ivuriro ubu, ategereje kuri {{station}}. Akabuto k’ubururu gafungura uko kwivuza: ibipimo, ibyanditswe, indwara yagaragaye, ubuvuzi, imiti n’ubwishyu byose byandikwa aho.
file.allergiesNoneHint: Kanda hano igihe umurwayi yabajijwe akaba nta kizwi umubiri we wanga. Bicapwa ku mpapuro z’imiti no kuri raporo.
file.privateFill: Ibanga ry’ubuvuzi: ntubona ibyanditswe muri ibi bice. Uzuza igice gusa iyo kirimo ubusa; icyari gihari kiragumaho.

clinical.title: Inyandiko z’ubuvuzi
clinical.readOnly: Abaganga, abaforomo n’umuyobozi ni bo bonyine bandika mu nyandiko z’ubuvuzi.
clinical.notePh: Icyamuzanye, amateka, ibyagaragaye mu isuzuma, gahunda…
clinical.testSaved: Ikizamini cyasabwe, cyashyizwe kuri fagitire no ku murongo.
clinical.finishHint: Indwara y’ingenzi yagaragaye irakenewe. Niba hari amafaranga atarishyurwa, umurwayi yoherezwa aho bakira ubwishyu.
clinical.finishConfirm: Gufunga uku kwivuza? Ibizamini bitararangira biguma bifunguye; fagitire itishyuwe yohereza umurwayi aho bakira ubwishyu.

errors.needPrimary: Andika indwara y’ingenzi yagaragaye mbere yo gufunga kwivuza.
errors.rxTwice: {{names}} yanditswe kabiri. Kuraho umurongo urenze, cyangwa wongere ukande Andika imiti kugira ngo yombi itangwe (buri umwe ushyirwa kuri fagitire).
errors.pickStore: Hitamo ububiko bw’icyumba buri muti utangwa hano uvamo.

clinical.dxHint: Indwara yagaragaye ni indwara cyangwa ikibazo wabonye nyuma yo gusuzuma umurwayi, urugero “Malariya yoroheje”. Iy’ingenzi = impamvu nyamukuru y’uku kwivuza; iyindi = ibindi bibazo byabonetse. Shyira akamenyetso kuri “By’agateganyo” igihe ugitegereje ibisubizo.
clinical.rxHint: Igice kimwe kuri buri muti. Koresha “Ongeraho undi muti” ku miti ifatanywa (urugero umuti wa malariya na parasetamoli). Yose yoherezwa muri farumasi icyarimwe.
clinical.rxSaved_one: Umuti wanditswe. Umurwayi ari ku murongo wa farumasi.
clinical.rxSaved_other: Imiti {{count}} yanditswe. Umurwayi ari ku murongo wa farumasi.
clinical.closedNote: Uku kwivuza kwarangiye: ibyanditswe hasi ni ibyo gusoma gusa kandi biguma muri dosiye y’umurwayi.
clinical.icdHint: ICD-10 ni kode mpuzamahanga y’indwara (B54 = malariya, A01.0 = tifoyide). Si ngombwa; iyo ishyizwemo, raporo zibara indwara nk’uko Minisiteri y’Ubuzima ibikora.
clinical.provisionalHint: Shyira akamenyetso kuri “By’agateganyo” iyo ukeka indwara ariko utarayemeza (urugero utegereje ikizamini). Ntugashyireho iyo indwara yemejwe.
clinical.testHint: Ntibisaba kubanza kumenya indwara: saba ibyo ukeneye kugira ngo umenye impamvu. Umurwayi ajya aho bikorerwa; ibisubizo byandikwa muri dosiye.
clinical.noTests: Nta kizamini cya laboratwari cyangwa isuzuma rya ekografi kiri ku rutonde.
clinical.sendNow: Ohereza umurwayi ubu, agaruke kuri njye ibisubizo nibimara kuboneka
clinical.testsSent_one: Ikizamini cyasabwe. Umurwayi agiye aho bapimira, azagaruka iwawe afite igisubizo.
clinical.testsSent_other: Ibizamini {{count}} byasabwe. Umurwayi agiye aho bapimira, azagaruka iwawe afite ibisubizo.

confirm.emergency: Gufungura ubu amakuru ya kera ya {{name}}, mu buryo bwihutirwa?
confirm.emergencyBody: Ahita afunguka kandi akaguma afunguye kugeza uku kwivuza kurangiye. Umuyobozi (n’uwo yahaye uburenganzira bwo gusubiza) amenyeshwa byihutirwa, bikandikwa mu mutuku ku rutonde rw’abarebye, kandi umuyobozi akagenzura impamvu yawe.
confirm.cancel: Gukuraho ubusabe bwawe bwo kureba amakuru ya {{name}}?
confirm.cancelBody: Umuyobozi (n’uwo yahaye uburenganzira bwo gusubiza) ntazongera kububona. Ushobora kongera gusaba nyuma.

recordPrivacy.canEmergencyOnly: Mu gihe cyihutirwa, ushobora kuyafungura ako kanya.
recordPrivacy.lockedTitle: Ntiwemerewe kureba amakuru yo kwivuza ya {{name}}
recordPrivacy.lockedNotError: Si ikibazo cya sisitemu: amakuru arahari, ariko ni ibanga.
recordPrivacy.lockedWhy: Inyandiko za muganga, indwara zabonetse, ibisubizo by’ibizamini, ibipimo by’ibanze n’impapuro z’imiti by’umurwayi bigaragarira gusa umuyobozi, abakuriye serivisi bireba n’abaganga cyangwa abaforomo bamuvura.
recordPrivacy.lockedAsk: Ni wowe uvura uyu murwayi ubu: kanda Saba kureba dosiye hejuru, uvuge impamvu ubikeneye.
recordPrivacy.lockedManager: Niba akazi kawe kabisaba, saba umuyobozi aguhe uburenganzira.
recordPrivacy.lockedStill: Ushobora kureba umwirondoro w’umurwayi, urutonde rw’inshuro yaje kwivuza na fagitire.
recordPrivacy.noneVisible: Nta na kimwe mu nshuro wemerewe kureba.

safetySummary.title: Incamake y’umutekano
safetySummary.lead: Ibyo buri wese uvura {{name}} agomba kumenya.
safetySummary.hidden: Ibyo umubiri we wanga, ubwoko bw’amaraso n’inyandiko bigaragarira abamuvura gusa. Biguma uko biri.
